group_id: sha256(canonical_json(key)); sorted keys, UTF-8, no whitespace
canonical_null_policy: floor_texture is JSON null when floor_mode is native.  null is a valid category, not a missing value: the full 20,000-frame audit reported zero missing group fields.  It is never rewritten to "None", "null" or "missing".
allocation: deterministic greedy over groups sorted by descending size then group_id; lexicographic objective: lowest fill ratio against the frame-count target, then marginal deviation across pallet_type/preset/background/diagnostic_mode, then group_id.  No random retry.
validates: generalization to an unseen exact appearance combination
robustness to background / floor / preset / pallet changes
does_not_validate: derived-frame leakage -- not applicable: every frame carries an independent render seed and the dataset contains no derived frames, camera sequences or appearance variants
